text: Completed optional scalafim-zarr-codec-blosc-zstd crossProject. Shared typed metadata and bounded Blosc-frame validation remain outside the dependency-free core; JVM uses blosc-java for full typesize read/write; Scala.js uses numcodecs embedded WASM, reads Python typesize 2 and 4 direct/sharded data, writes and verifies only fixed typesize 4, and rejects other write strides. Core tests passed JVM 77 and JS 75; provider tests passed JVM 10 and JS 10; Zarr-Python 3.2.1 reconstructed Scala direct and sharded float32 outputs. Measured dependencies: JVM jar 2,058,408 bytes; JS blosc module 614,996 raw and 206,025 gzip. Decision: Go as optional fMRI-oriented provider; NoGo as core dependency or general Scala.js writer. Browser-engine execution remains a later release gate; current Scala.js evidence is Node 24 on Darwin arm64.
